facts.maturity: announced demonstrations; not a confirmed customer production order
demonstrations announced; adoption and revenue contribution not quantified
company-level revenue verified; product, customer, Tomahawk 6 and CPO contribution not disclosed

facts.product_scope: Certain vertical power delivery systems, components thereof, and computing systems containing the same
facts.requested_remedies: Limited exclusion order and cease and desist orders requested by complainant
facts.stage: Investigation instituted; no decision on merits; requested remedies have not been granted

facts.reported_driver: Longer AI-chip test time and custom-chip demand constrain effective test capacity
facts.attribution: Industry sources quoted by Economic Daily News; not a disclosed company-wide contractual price increase
facts.scope_limit: Company, product, contract coverage and effective dates remain unverified

facts.source_nature: Company statements reported by Central News Agency; direct Delta and Quanta filings were not retrieved in this run
facts.delta: Said the relevant products are currently unaffected and it will respond through the legal process
facts.quanta: Said the relevant products and operations are unaffected and it will require the relevant suppliers to handle the component dispute and respond
facts.hon_hai: Said its initial assessment found no material impact on production, shipments or customer cooperation
facts.interpretation: Near-term operations are reported unchanged; Quanta's supplier-response wording makes contractual responsibility and cost allocation a specific unresolved question
facts.stage: Company responses; no regulator decision on merits or remedy

facts.reporting_basis: Q3 2026 company self-reported consolidated results, unaudited
facts.ai_infrastructure_revenue_share: more than 20 percent, including servers, networking, storage and system management
facts.pricing_mechanism: Q3 ASP increase attributed by the company mainly to renewed long-term contracts
facts.q4_supply_view: low supplier inventory; AI compute demand constrains memory supply for smartphones, PCs and consumer applications
facts.expansion_condition: future expansion primarily targets customer long-term-contract AI projects
facts.capacity_plan: equipment installation planned for Q1 2027; 30,000 wafers per month by end-2028 and 50,000 by end-2030
facts.technology_milestone: 1C customer qualification planned for Q1 2027; 1D, 1E and EUV development reported on schedule
facts.interpretation: The quarter provides direct company evidence that AI-related memory tightness and contract repricing, rather than shipment growth, are driving current profit expansion; durability depends on contract pricing, customer commitments, qualification and the supply ramp.

facts.source_nature: Reuters report citing an LSEG SmartEstimate and a dated Morgan Stanley research view; not TSMC reported results or guidance
facts.official_q3_revenue_context: TSMC reported approximately TWD 1.49 trillion for Q3 2026, above the prior USD 44.6-45.8 billion company guidance range
facts.interpretation: This establishes the market hurdle for the October 15 earnings call. It is not evidence that TSMC has already raised guidance; re-rating depends on reported profit, margins, full-year guidance and forward demand commentary.

facts.source_nature: Reuters reporting on Microsoft's announcement and executive interview, corroborated by The Verge quoting Microsoft Cloud EVP Scott Guthrie; the indexed Microsoft primary announcement was not retrieved in this run
facts.deployment_scale: Microsoft said multi-gigawatt deployments and Reuters reported potentially more than one million chips
facts.intended_role: Primary AI inference system for Microsoft products and services
facts.foundry_and_process: TSMC 2nm for key compute chiplets and lower-cost 3nm for chiplets handling data movement and other functions
facts.prior_generation_comparison: Microsoft claims up to 7x Maia 200 rack-scale token throughput
facts.efficiency_claim: Microsoft claims about 40 percent more useful compute or tokens per megawatt than leading GPU-based systems
facts.benchmark_limit: Microsoft did not name the GPU system used as the comparison baseline in the Reuters report
facts.csp_capex_context: Microsoft expects more than USD 175 billion of calendar-year capital expenditure
facts.interpretation: The announcement confirms a shift from exploratory custom silicon to a planned fleet-scale inference platform and directly supports TSMC N2/N3 demand. It increases long-term substitution risk for marginal NVIDIA and AMD inference demand, but does not establish delivered volume, external customer adoption, supplier revenue or a near-term reduction in GPU purchases.

facts.compute_process: TSMC N2P for compute chiplets; memory-controller and I/O functions separated onto dies optimized for bandwidth, connectivity and cost
facts.hbm_per_accelerator: 8 HBM4 stacks, 288 GB capacity and 18 TB/s bandwidth
facts.network_topology: In-rack electrical links; optical second tier across racks
facts.power_delivery: Dual feeds, high-capacity power shelves and 50 V busbar
facts.cooling: Liquid cooling removes more than 80 percent of rack thermal load; remaining components use air cooling
facts.derived_content_at_reported_potential_sc: If Reuters' potential scale of more than one million accelerators is realized, accelerator HBM content would exceed eight million HBM4 stacks; this is a scenario calculation, not a confirmed purchase order
facts.benchmark_limit: Microsoft comparisons are vendor-reported and primarily versus Maia 200; the disclosed architecture page does not name third-party suppliers for HBM, switch ASICs, optics, power or cooling
facts.interpretation: The primary architecture turns Maia 300 from a foundry-only demand signal into a measurable HBM4, optical interconnect, liquid-cooling and rack-power content map. Re-rating for individual suppliers still requires named awards, qualified shipments and revenue or margin attribution.

facts.source_nature: GlobalFoundries primary company announcement, corroborated by Reuters
facts.scope: GlobalFoundries will manufacture silicon interposers for TSMC's CoWoS advanced-packaging ecosystem
facts.capacity_action: GlobalFoundries will add fabrication capacity, including capability supporting embedded deep-trench-capacitor components
facts.production_timing: Volume production expected to begin ramping in the first half of 2028
facts.strategic_role: First U.S.-based source of silicon interposers supporting TSMC's CoWoS ecosystem, according to GlobalFoundries
facts.disclosed_limits: Annual capacity, product allocation, end customers, payment cadence, utilization, pricing, margins and any TSMC volume guarantee were not disclosed
facts.interpretation: The agreement adds a contracted U.S. interposer source and turns advanced-packaging geographic resilience into a funded manufacturing program. It is direct long-duration AI exposure for GlobalFoundries and may ease TSMC CoWoS interposer constraints after 2028, but does not establish near-term capacity relief or supplier revenue recognition.

facts.source_nature: Company-supplied deployment release reproduced by multiple industry publications; CapitaLand's property page independently confirms the site's 108 MW planned power capacity, but neither Vertiv nor CapitaLand posted a matching investor announcement retrieved in this run
facts.project: Direct-to-chip high-density liquid cooling deployment at CLDC Mumbai 01 in Airoli, Navi Mumbai
facts.system: Vertiv secondary fluid network (SFN) technology-loop skids
facts.completion_evidence: Vertiv says design, installation and commissioning were completed and Level 4 testing was conducted ahead of go-live
facts.manufacturing_action: Vertiv built an India production facility capable of higher-volume manufacture of customized technology-loop skids
facts.site_context: CapitaLand India Trust lists CLDC Mumbai 01 as a 108 MW facility under development
facts.disclosed_limits: No contract value, order date, named hyperscaler, revenue-recognition timing, gross-margin contribution, deployed rack count or repeat-order commitment was disclosed
facts.interpretation: This is operational evidence that direct-to-chip cooling has moved from reference designs into a completed 30 MW hyperscale deployment in India. It strengthens the liquid-cooling adoption thesis and Vertiv's local execution credentials, but the missing contract economics mean it is not yet evidence of an earnings revision or durable multiple re-rating.

facts.source_nature: NVIDIA primary OCP announcement quoting Meta infrastructure leadership
facts.customer_and_product: Meta is adopting NVIDIA Spectrum-6 102.4 Tb/s Ethernet switches in its N-IceCube system for the liquid-cooled IcePack rack
facts.architecture: Spectrum-X Multiplane uses Spectrum-6 switches and ConnectX-9 SuperNICs across as many as eight independent network planes
facts.scale_target: The architecture is designed to support Vera Rubin AI factories beyond 100,000 GPUs
facts.software_control: Meta extends FBOSS to Spectrum ASICs through the OCP Switch Abstraction Interface
facts.deployment_boundary: Meta describes N-IceCube as connecting upcoming accelerator generations; the disclosure does not provide installed switch counts, purchase value, deployment date or revenue timing
facts.interpretation: A named hyperscaler design adoption raises NVIDIA's credibility as a merchant Ethernet switching supplier beyond its GPU attach. It creates a real competitive signal for Broadcom, Cisco and other AI fabric vendors, but is not yet a disclosed production-volume or earnings-revision event.

facts.source_nature: Cisco primary OCP press release with direct customer statements from Microsoft and Alibaba
facts.microsoft_deployment: Microsoft says systems powered by Cisco Silicon One P200 have moved into production
facts.alibaba_deployment: Alibaba says its in-house Quantum Cat routers using Cisco Silicon One P200 have been deployed at massive scale in the eCORE backbone
facts.p200_system: 51.2 Tb/s deep-buffered routing systems for scale-across and backbone workloads
facts.g300_status: First 102.4 Tb/s Silicon One G300-powered systems are shipping to customers
facts.g302_status: Cisco plans customer shipments of its 51.2 Tb/s G302 top-of-rack silicon before the end of 2026
facts.disclosed_limits: Cisco did not disclose chip or system volumes, contract value, customer concentration, product gross margins or revenue-recognition timing
facts.interpretation: The named production deployments move Cisco Silicon One from product availability into hyperscaler validation and create a more credible AI-networking revenue path. The missing economics prevent direct EPS attribution, but the evidence weakens the assumption that Broadcom and NVIDIA will capture nearly all merchant AI networking value.

facts.source_nature: Joint Constellation and Google company announcements corroborated by Reuters
facts.nuclear_asset_scope: Upgrades at 11 Constellation-owned nuclear units across six sites in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey
facts.delivery_timing: First uprate expected by 2028; Google says all 890 MW should be added before the end of 2032
facts.commercial_mechanism: Google's long-term offtake provides revenue certainty for uprates while the 2,700 MW agreement supports continued operation of existing PJM assets
facts.flexibility: Agreement includes load shaping and demand-response capability during high-stress grid events
facts.technology_alliance: Constellation selected Google Cloud and Gemini Enterprise under an expanded five-year alliance for planning, asset optimization and critical-infrastructure operations
facts.disclosed_limits: Power prices, take-or-pay structure, annual cash-flow profile, project-level returns, regulatory milestones and data-center load locations were not disclosed
facts.interpretation: The agreement shows CSP capital commitments moving upstream from data-center equipment into long-duration generation economics. Constellation gains a contracted path to invest USD 4.3 billion and monetize both incremental and existing capacity, while Google reduces power-availability risk. The 15- to 20-year duration supports a structural earnings-quality argument, but returns still depend on undisclosed pricing, execution and regulatory outcomes.

facts.source_nature: Matching primary announcements from LG Electronics and AIR Control Concepts
facts.agreement: Long-term supply agreement for advanced chillers supporting AI data-center projects
facts.delivery_description: LG says cooling solutions will be supplied sequentially across AIR-supported projects
facts.customer_scope: AIR serves leading global data-center operators, but neither announcement names the operators or project sites
facts.company_chiller_revenue_target: approximately USD 680 million (KRW 1 trillion), originally targeted for 2027 and now expected ahead of schedule
facts.energy_efficiency_claim: LG internal simulation says refrigerant free-cooling used about 30 percent less annual energy than waterside free-cooling for one 1,750 kW unit under Seoul-area climate conditions
facts.disclosed_limits: No contract value, committed purchase minimum, chiller count, delivery schedule, named data-center customer, site, revenue-recognition cadence or margin contribution was disclosed
facts.interpretation: The signed long-term agreement moves LG's AI cooling exposure from project bids toward a portfolio supply relationship and supports a structural B2B growth thesis. The 5 GW figure measures supported data-center project capacity rather than chiller output or order value, so supplier earnings attribution still requires purchase volumes, delivery timing and margins.

facts.source_nature: Meta Engineering primary disclosure at OCP Global Summit 2026
facts.current_scale_up: Meta said Tahan is shipping today for MTIA 300; it uses Broadcom Tomahawk 5 51.2 Tbps silicon, four switches interconnect 16 accelerators, and the system provides 6.4 Tbps per accelerator
facts.current_scale_out: Meta disclosed two 102.4 Tbps IceCube variants, one using Broadcom Tomahawk 6C and one using NVIDIA Spectrum-6; each provides 128x800G non-blocking switching and runs FBOSS through OCP SAI
facts.next_generation_preview: A previewed 216x400G scale-up blade uses Broadcom Tomahawk 6C; eight switches are intended to interconnect 72 accelerators per rack, with a future generation planned to adopt ESUN
facts.regional_backbone: Meta said its deployed SRv6 regional backbone uses open shallow-buffer platforms powered by Cisco Silicon One, while additional silicon families are being onboarded
facts.software_control_point: FBOSS and OCP SAI abstract the silicon families, preserving multi-vendor choice across Broadcom, NVIDIA and Cisco rather than locking the fleet to one switch ASIC supplier
facts.economics_limit: No installed system count, procurement value, supplier revenue recognition, gross margin or exact deployment schedule was disclosed for the new IceCube and next-generation systems
facts.interpretation: The disclosure adds a named, current Broadcom scale-up design and confirms deliberate multi-vendor silicon use across Meta's AI network. It strengthens Broadcom's production exposure but also shows that value is split with NVIDIA and Cisco and that the operator's software layer preserves substitution options.

facts.source_nature: Reuters report quoting Broadcom CEO Hock Tan at a Singapore panel
facts.management_comment: Tan said Broadcom is overcoming wafer and memory shortages and that capital will be the biggest constraint as AI development continues
facts.interpretation: This is a counter-signal to the assumption that memory scarcity must remain the dominant AI infrastructure bottleneck. If confirmed by supplier inventory, lead-time and contract-price data, value could shift from memory scarcity toward financing capacity and project economics.
facts.evidence_limit: The report provides no product-specific lead time, inventory, HBM or DRAM supply-demand balance, pricing, contract term or forecast revision; it does not by itself overturn Nanya Technology's company-reported Q3 contract repricing evidence.

facts.large_load_threshold: 50 MW cumulative peak at one electrical site; affiliated facilities within one mile aggregate
rejected: Bring Your Own New Capacity rules
facts.basis: FERC found jurisdictional and undue-discrimination issues in the proposed curtailment framework
facts.next_step: PJM may refile a revised proposal and must make a compliance filing within 30 days
facts.interpretation: The immediate PJM-wide curtailment mechanism was not approved, but the registry increases project-level visibility and the power shortfall remains unresolved

facts.action: Directs PJM to dispatch specified units as needed and authorizes backup generation at large loads as a last resort before or during EEA 3
facts.maturity: Authorization and dispatch framework; actual backup-generator activation, duration and affected facilities are not yet disclosed
facts.interpretation: A fresh emergency order confirms that near-term grid reliability remains a live deployment constraint even as FERC rejected PJM's standing IRAS curtailment design

facts.source_nature: CXMT primary disclosure for G5 and LPDDR5X mass production; subsequent reporting of CXMT president Cao Kanyu's October 2026 conference remarks for the 4F² server-memory plan
facts.g5_dies_per_wafer_change: At least 50 percent higher than the prior platform when normalized at 8Gb
facts.current_product_scope_limit: The primary mass-production disclosure is mobile LPDDR5X, not server DDR5 RDIMM
facts.announced_architecture: 4F² DRAM cell using a vertical-surrounded-gate transistor
facts.announced_server_product: DDR5 RDIMM planned by the end of 2026
facts.maturity: Product plan and architecture progress; server qualification, yield, volume production, customer adoption and capacity are not disclosed
facts.interpretation: This raises a medium-term downside risk to the server-DRAM scarcity and pricing thesis, but it is not evidence of immediate qualified server supply or 2026 market oversupply

facts.architecture: Open Compute Project specification-based blueprint with CPU-only hyperscale and EPYC plus MI350P integrated configurations
facts.status: Configurations are under development with ecosystem partners
facts.maturity: Reference design and partner support announcement; no named end-customer order, shipment volume, procurement value, revenue or margin contribution
facts.interpretation: The announcement defines a near-term route to market for AMD rack-scale agentic infrastructure and a watch list for Taiwan ODM participation, but it does not yet establish a design-win or re-rating event for any partner

facts.source_nature: Reuters reporting on an IDC report seen by Reuters; the underlying IDC report and methodology were not retrieved in this run
facts.domestic_non_gpu_share: Huawei, T-Head, Kunlunxin and Cambricon together accounted for 95 percent of the non-GPU segment
facts.idc_full_year_view: Total accelerator shipments expected to grow 19 percent while GPU shipments fall 9 percent
facts.maturity: Third-party shipment estimate; product definitions, ASP, revenue share, utilization and IDC methodology remain unavailable
facts.interpretation: Export controls and domestic procurement are shifting Chinese AI infrastructure from imported GPUs toward local non-GPU accelerators and system-level integration. This is a material regional share loss for NVIDIA, not evidence of a comparable change in NVIDIA global revenue or share.

facts.official_status: Proposed international notes offering under the global medium-term note programme; no binding agreement existed at the announcement date and completion remained conditional
facts.capex_scope: IT infrastructure including computer equipment, components and software; data centres; land-use rights; office premises; and intellectual property excluding media content
facts.liquidity_statement: Tencent said existing cash, operating cash flow and term deposits should be sufficient for anticipated operations and capital expenditure for at least the next 12 months
facts.reported_term_sheet_update: Reuters reported a four-tranche USD and offshore-yuan sale that could raise at least USD 4.5 billion, with books exceeding USD 2 billion for the dollar tranches and RMB 35 billion for the yuan tranches
facts.proceeds_limit: General corporate purposes; the proposed notes are not disclosed as dedicated AI-project financing
facts.maturity: Offering was being marketed; final principal, pricing, completion and allocation of proceeds were not yet company-confirmed
facts.interpretation: Tencent's H1 capital spending step-up confirms a large China-CSP infrastructure demand pool and the proposed long-dated funding preserves financing capacity. It does not prove capital stress or identify supplier orders because Tencent states internal liquidity is sufficient and the proceeds are general corporate.

facts.source_nature: MediaTek official company blog summarizing Computex remarks by Vince Hu; company guidance and marketing claims, not audited segment reporting
facts.advanced_node_execution: MediaTek states 10+ TSMC N3 tape-outs, 2+ N2 tape-outs, and an A14 test-chip tape-out planned later in 2026
facts.platform_scope: Custom ASIC, advanced packaging, HBM interface, UCIe/custom die-to-die, SerDes, uLED, Ethernet, NVLink Fusion, CPO and rack integration
facts.interpretation: The disclosure strengthens the evidence that data-center ASIC is already material to MediaTek and is intended to expand from design service into rack-level integration. The US$2 billion figure is company guidance; the 10-15% target and TAM do not establish orders, revenue timing or margins.

coverage.note: Counts use distinct active-universe companies with an identified primary-source fact, not the number of source checks. Accton's partner relationship and monthly revenue count as one company; an earlier count of five had double-counted Accton. Hon Hai and Quanta were added from the regulator event, and Nanya Technology was added from its Q3 2026 company results. Primary-source validation remains partial; no full-universe or valuation conclusion is claimed. Vertiv is not in the current 98-company alpha-quant universe; this run added it as an out-of-universe supplier candidate because a completed 30 MW hyperscale liquid-cooling deployment provides explicit demand-transmission evidence. LG Electronics is not in the current 98-company alpha-quant universe; it was added as an out-of-universe supplier candidate because the signed AIR long-term agreement covers AI data-center projects exceeding 5 GW, while contract value and delivery economics remain undisclosed.
